title: App Icon
slide_intent: Show how to introduce a changed icon while helping existing customers distinguish two apps.
strategic_value: A phased change can preserve recognition for the main app, while a paper bag identifies the shopper app.
demonstration: Two columns compare launch and future versions. Each pairs a primary icon with a shopper icon and flags a pending bag-color update.
practical_value: Choose the appropriate version for the launch stage and distinguish the primary app from the shopper app.
